fields.summary: TC-761-01: Phase 2 COA Lambdas Execute Successfully After Node 22.x Upgrade

content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-761
Precondition: All Phase 2 COA Processor Repo Lambdas have been upgraded to Node 22.x runtime. A valid COA record with audit-eligible trip data exists to trigger Phase 2 audit processing.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Verify the runtime configuration of all Phase 2 COA Lambdas in AWS console or via CLI
AWS Lambda console / CLI for crew-qa2-techp Phase 2 COA Lambdas (LCO, LRO, RRO, Blaze, DB update)
All Phase 2 COA Lambdas show Node.js 22.x as the configured runtime
Trigger the Phase 2 pay audit workflow Step Function with a valid audit-eligible trip
Audit-eligible trip: COA_CSS_TOGGLE=TRUE, COA_CSS_PHASE_2_TOGGLE=TRUE, trip release time passed, auditNeeded=true
Phase 2 audit Step Function is invoked and begins processing with Node 22.x Lambdas
Verify LCO, LRO, and RRO Lambdas (all on Node 22.x) execute without runtime errors
CloudWatch Logs for LCO Lambda, LRO Lambda, RRO Lambda during audit processing
All three Lambdas complete successfully on Node 22.x with no deprecated API errors or incompatibilities
Verify the Blaze Pull Lambda and DB update Lambda (Node 22.x) complete successfully
CloudWatch Logs for Blaze Pull Lambda and DB update Lambda
Blaze Pull Lambda and DB update Lambda execute without errors on Node 22.x runtime
Verify the Phase 2 audit result is correctly written to DynamoDB and reflected in COA Search App after full Node 22.x processing
DynamoDB audit record and COA Search App after Phase 2 execution
DynamoDB and COA Search App show correct audit status and LCO/LRO/RRO results - no data loss or corruption from Node 22.x upgrade
